method.communities: independent port of synchronous label propagation (modules/spark job06), validated against analytics-report.json

expected.population_caveat: the runtime ranks only the researchers inside its bounded artifact; the top list is corpus-wide

questions.question: Which researchers have the most distinct coauthors?

required_text.note: the text must name the rank-1 cited researcher and state that researcher's value

acceptable_abstention_forms: HTTP 200 answer with outcome ABSTAINED and no verified ranking claim
HTTP 422 with the closed error code UNSUPPORTED_QUERY
expected.forbidden: any ranking of researchers presented as filtered by the topic
expected.reason: no researcher has authoritative topic metadata in the export (3 TOPIC nodes, all on 1 work with no AUTHORED edge); the runtime rejects the filtered ranking (unsupported-authoritative-filter-metadata) and must abstain
